description: Defines a template class 'pucch_format1_map' that maps elements of type T to PUCCH Format 1 initial cyclic shifts and time domain OCC indices, including iterators, insertion, access, and utility functions.

classes.name: pucch_format1_map
classes.description: Template class that manages a mapping from cyclic shift and OCC indices to elements of type T, with iterator support and range checks.

classes.name: pucch_format1_map::const_iterator
classes.description: Read-only iterator class for traversing active entries in 'pucch_format1_map', providing coordinate and value access.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an element exists at specified cyclic shift and OCC indices.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs a new element in-place at specified indices with provided arguments.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new element with a given value at specified indices.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to the element at specified indices (modifiable or const).

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the map.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of active elements.
